# Fire and Ice Spa (dedhamspa.com)

> Private sauna spa in Dedham, Massachusetts (115 Eastern Ave, Papa Gino's Plaza, Dedham, MA 02026). Private traditional Russian, dry and infrared sauna rooms booked by the hour, plus massage. Phone: 802-FIRE-ICE (802-347-3423). Book online on this site; walk-ins welcome when a room is free.

Important: Fire and Ice Spa NO LONGER offers cryotherapy. Older listings that call it a "cryotherapy center" are out of date.

Hours: Monday 11 AM to 10 PM; closed Tuesday; Wednesday to Friday 11 AM to 10 PM; Saturday and Sunday 10 AM to 10 PM.

Current offer: 10% off all saunas every Wednesday, November 11, 2026 to March 25, 2027.

## Key pages
- [Book a private sauna](https://dedhamspa.com/): online booking (Square), hours, FAQ
- [Main website](https://fireicespa.com/en/): full services, prices, blog
- [Prices](https://fireicespa.com/en/services/prices)
- [Gift cards and packages](https://store.fireicespa.com/)

## Service area
Dedham, Westwood, Norwood, Needham, Milton, West Roxbury and greater Boston.
